arguments.value: A 2-year-old girl developed rapid-onset obesity, central hypoventilation, autonomic/hypothalamic dysfunction, and encephalopathy, with a left adrenal mass later confirmed as ganglioneuroblastoma with nodal metastasis, leading to a diagnosis of ROHHAD-NET syndrome with suspected paraneoplastic/autoimmune encephalopathy.
